q01.why: 6 facilities ranked on one metric (MW): horizontal ranked bars beat columns (not a time series) and bk22 (no median needed)

q02.why: 4 markets on one unit (US$/kW/month), Singapore highlighted: ranked bar is the house precedent for market comparisons

q03.why: 4 text takeaways beside a deal exhibit: bold lead-in bullets; takeaway holds only one sentence, pill_rows is for overviews

q04.why: 4 commentary points (cap rates, price/MW, accretion, implication) beside benchmarks: bullets fit commentary, not a lead exhibit

q05.why: Deal terms with mixed labelled values (price, area, tenants, WALE, DPU) need exact reading: table beats a stat strip

q06.why: 5 headline numbers in a row on a risks page: stat strip sits under the risk table; icons add little

q07.why: 7-category industry mix for a combined company vs standalones: before/after donuts, matching the investment-type precedent

q08.why: One headline offer price ($13.25) with 3 supporting premiums: hero number beats an equal-weight strip; no price range for bk01

q09.why: 4 sentence-length financing points (debt, rollover, no contingency): bullets; no tranche terms for a term sheet

q10.why: 7 peers with a multiple (x) at several dates and medians: precedent table with inline bars, per the multiple-change precedents

q11.why: IRR on two driver pairs (entry/exit with price, and leverage): twin sensitivity tables beat a single heatmap

q12.why: Case 2 of two management cases, 5 numeric text lines: two-case comparison per the Case 1 projections precedent

q13.why: EBITDA by 7 segments over 2023E-2027E (US$mm): stacked columns show mix over time; one chart, not four panels

q14.why: Equity value, EV and multiples at several prices: offer summary table, per the offer-sensitivity precedent

q15.why: 3 options (exclusive/targeted/broad) scored on 3 criteria, no numbers: Harvey balls show the scoring at a glance

q16.why: 3-4 alternatives (sell, hold, spin) with cases and required growth: comparison matrix per the alternatives precedent

q17.why: Liquidity grid on two drivers (LTM revenue x % of revenue), 25 cells: two-way sensitivity grid

q18.why: 6 customer verticals as names with no detail plus a count: logo/tile wall per the partners precedent

q19.why: 8 sentence-length proposal terms: headed bullet list; bk01 needs a range of prices, not one offer

q20.why: 6 short modelling assumptions with mixed measures: bullets beside the proposal; no shared unit for a chart

q21.why: 5 headline financing metrics (WAM, WACD, flex, fees) in a row under a term sheet: stat strip, no icons needed

q22.why: 6 annual values in one unit ($MM): column for market size over time; too few points for a line

q23.why: Premium % per precedent with median rows: precedent table with inline bars; more than 5 rows for bk25

q24.why: Value per share across discount rate/multiple vs dilution: two-way price sensitivity grid vs unaffected price

q25.why: 8 valuation ranges in $ per share vs offers: football field; no per-method commentary for bk15

q26.why: Cost line items with $ and % of sales over 2024E-2028E: bank-format financial table

q27.why: Two forecast cases compared on GWP and underwriting profit: plan vs plan chart grid per the Case 1 vs Case 2 precedent

q28.why: 10 rows of price, equity value, EV and multiples at successive offers: offer summary table

q29.why: 5 methods each with a description, no numbers: methodology overview per precedent

q30.why: 3 firm-size tiers (large to small) with counts and on-prem vs cloud reach: pyramid tiers; not nested TAM/SAM/SOM

q31.why: Peers on 2 metrics (growth, margin) with medians: benchmarking bar matrix; bk22 is one metric only

q32.why: Accretion % grids for 2019E and 2020E on multiple x equity share: twin sensitivity tables

q33.why: 9 process actions by week over 4 months: Gantt timeline per precedent; too long for a calendar

q34.why: 6 dated financing/covenant events alongside the process: calendar with key dates per precedent

q35.why: One short framing note (advisor role): takeaway box; a single point is too thin for bullets

q36.why: 11 peers on one multiple (x) with median lines: ranked columns with medians

q37.why: One measure toward a target (US$1.6bn of 2.0bn): thermometer for fundraising progress

q38.why: 3 headline percentages with captions: three % rings; NRR over 100% can cap the ring

q39.why: 3 single-period splits (segment, region, customer) of 2-3 parts: three donuts side by side

q40.why: 5 APAC countries with MW capacity: Asia Pacific country map; 5 places is above map_pins comfort

q41.why: Bull vs bear, 2 cases with exit values: two-way arrows per precedent

q42.why: 4 gaps filled by the target, short labels: jigsaw fit shows strategic fit better than a hub

q43.why: 3 revenue streams merging into one combined company: three streams into one arrow

q44.why: 6 equal capabilities, one word each: six hexagon columns with icons

q45.why: Segment to product breakdown with % at each level: sunburst shows the levels; stacked if proportions must be exact

q46.why: 4 strengths with icons, mixed numbers and text: numbered icon pillars; stat_icons needs all numbers

q47.why: A plan that splits into protect vs grow branches of 3 actions: branching process (protect vs enhance)
